note: mono-park-timing-1117 (PREPARED, NOT RUN; copy of mono-park-timing-1115 repinned to master-1116c (0.36.267-mc1116), Bin state apex, rewind off (separate loads are the design); NEEDS QUIET MACHINE, clean night): unseenpark D1 timing (docs/243 §7/§9). Why unseenpark-1113 timing was invalid: every row noise medium (other apps 8.4-12.7% of game CPUs) because every job had noiseCheck false, so queue.ts never stopped or reran a noisy job; also the in-load 2-min --ab slices mix arms for a hold of 30 sim-min (switching OFF releases every held Sim into the next off slice, switching ON starts with no backlog), off first and last gave 503 s off vs 420 s on, and only one order ran (raw, invalid: BP +1.5, IP +10.0 ms/s on - off, i.e. ON slower). Fixed here: separate loads in ABBA order per world (off on on off) x BP, IP, SV, 10 min each, noise check on (queue.ts stops a job at >= 10% other CPU or a clock drop and reruns it once as <id>-rerun), unseenprobe off in both arms (not shipped), switch read back per job by fixesRequire. ~13 jobs x ~12 min = ~2.6 h plus noise reruns. Run: through a chain that sets Bin state apex (tools/turbo-compat.ts) and installs game-copy/ts3agent.package.master-1116c as build/ts3agent.package: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/mono-park-timing-1117.json; then node tools/harness/arm-ms.ts mono-park-timing-1117, run-verdict.ts, hitch-ab.ts. Stop rule (docs/243 §7): pooled on - off sum ms/s <= -5 (a gain of >= 5 ms/s) on BP and IP with both ABBA halves the same sign, hitches not worse, routing bars R1-R6 OK; 0-5 = one fix round (poll cost: held Sims poll every 2 ticks, ~380 polls/s on BP, docs/243 §9.2), then park. Default stays OFF; Rodney decides ON.

smoke.note: Measurement smoke (AGENTS.md): BP 10 min ON arm: fixes on unseenpark (verified) line, unseen_park_held >= 1, heavy tools off, noise checked. The OFF read-back (held 0) is proven by the first real job, which stops the queue on FAIL.
